The dateFrom and dateTo fields define the date range and are applied to the field selected by docFilteredBy. Outer request structure: {
"jws": ""
} The decrypted JWS payload must match: SalesInvoiceRequest Filtered by date can be filtered by fields docReceivedTimestamp or docDate, based on the dateFilterBy parameter. By default, the filter is applied to the docDate field.
